title: Prometheus system: brain-neural interface built from a psychic child's brain waves

tellings.quote: what they were trying to do is build a brain neural interface, right?

plain: Between about 2008 and 2010, at a children's services center called Baker Victory Services in New York, researchers were reportedly recording a psychic child's brain waves to build what was called the Prometheus system. In his words, "what they were trying to do is build a brain neural interface," meaning a link between a brain and a machine. The account comes from Jordan Jose, a man who says he was that child and was taken into a secret program, and if it were true it would mean children's minds were being used to build hidden technology.
